scope: In-memory, fixed synthetic prototype state only; page reload intentionally returns to initial state.

transitions.postcondition: answer=safe; health Advice may be shown
transitions.visible_receipt: 无警示：出现一个低风险、可停止的候选
跳过不是安全回答；保持保守
停止相关建议并建议适当专业支持

transitions.postcondition: feedback=modified; original Advice remains visible; execution=not_executed
transitions.visible_receipt: 修改后接受；原 Advice 未被改写
延后；不自动排程或提醒
EXE 是用户报告，不代表结果
仅当日理解更新：今晚不再追加训练型建议
待确认、有限范围、不会影响未来日期
原型内确认有限范围；不产生真实持久化
候选被拒绝；结果历史未删除

transitions.postcondition: source_failure in {missing,stale,conflict,unauthorized}; all health Advice hidden
transitions.visible_receipt: 来源条件不成立：关闭个性化建议

transitions.postcondition: answer=unanswered; feedback/result/memory reset; dependent derivation/advice stale
transitions.visible_receipt: 已撤销本次链路；原 Source 身份未被改写

transitions.postcondition: return to initial in-memory state; no persistence
transitions.visible_receipt: 刷新后只显示初始合成原型状态

invariants: Person is the only top-level subject; Project appears only as work context.
Health training-style Advice is never visible for unanswered, skip, warning, or source-failure states.
Advice, Feedback, Execution, Result, Derivation, and Memory candidate remain visibly distinct.
Memory candidate is pending and limited by default; it cannot affect a future date before confirmation.
No event writes storage, calls a network, invokes a model, database, file system, Tauri, or IPC.
